items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: we got Ram. on piano -- Kirby got Ram Ramirez. He was a fine piano player.

ctx.x: He was in that reorganized band -- Ben Webster?
Uh huh. And we had intended to take Billy Kyle's place, who was down in the South Pacific, and we got Ram. on piano -- Kirby got Ram Ramirez. He was a fine piano player.
